hypothesis.statement: Adaptive Discovery requires each evidence-triggered reformulation to have its own typed, state-bound semantic proposal rather than inheriting only the initial semantic call.
falsifiable_predictions: A semantic reformulation should cite the exact contradictory observation and differ from its parent hypothesis while the controller remains the only source of the REFORMULATE_HYPOTHESIS action.
Unknown observation identifiers should reject the proposal before a reformulation state is published.
A post-generation execution failure should resume from the same ledger entry without a second backend call.

retained_constraints: Keep semantic output proposal-only and preserve deterministic action selection.
Bind every accepted proposal to project revision, predecessor state, usage, recording, and ledger hashes.
alternative_explanations: A richer deterministic reformulation template could provide some content diversity without a second semantic node.
output_payload.uncertainty: The scripted self-iteration verifies state, authority, budget, and recovery contracts but does not measure open-ended scientific quality.
